During a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was kidnapped by [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], two clanless [[Ansionian]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] ([[Alwari]] outcasts, formerly of the [[Tasbir]] clan). She was kidnapped on the order of [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]]. The kidnapping took place in a [[Unidentified Cuipernam marketplace|marketplace]] in [[Cuipernam]], capital of Ansion. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their Padawans Barriss Offee and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were walking through the marketplace, Barriss was lured away and sprayed with a gas that rendered her unconscious. After being taken to the room of an unnamed building on [[Jaaruls Street]] by her captors, Barriss was able to convince them to release her by curing them of mental disabilities that they had been living with for years. The cured assailants, Kyakhta and Bulgan, then decided to join the Jedi as guides on their mission to end the ongoing conflicts between the [[Unity of Community]], Ansion's official government, and the Alwari nomads.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
